name: AFM level 1 task 10: Spatially Resolved Roughness And Friction
description: Treat the initial scan center as (0 µm, 0 µm). Acquire one contact-mode lateral-force image centered at the origin using a scan size of 2 µm × 2 µm, resolution of 256 × 256 pixels, time per line of 0.075 s, setpoint of 0.1 V, and P/I/D gains of 100/50/0. From this single acquisition, calculate rms and mean roughness from the height channel and average friction magnitude and spatial standard deviation from the lateral channels.
